findings.finding: The Q3 release will carry the company's first 2027 guide, and the company has already told the market to expect 'accelerated growth in 2027 and beyond' toward a NOK 400-500m 2029 EBITDA ambition, while the stock (NOK 11.8) trades 28% below the June placement at NOK 16.50 and ~29% below the Q2 close.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Feb 2026 'expects accelerating growth' release fell 3.8%; Aug 2026 reiteration of 2026 guide fell 6.9%; no prior first-guide event for a new year on the listed entity in this form.
findings.why_not_priced: The guide does not exist yet; a 30% drawdown since August on no negative company news implies the price is discounting the ambition path (EV ~NOK 1.8bn vs 2026 PF EBITDA 190-230m, ~8x), so an on-path guide is not in the price; if it were priced the stock would sit near the placement price and the analysts' ~NOK 24 targets.

findings.finding: The 2026 guide is only just covered by the pro forma run-rate: Q2 2026 PF defence revenue was flat YoY (245.4m vs 241.9m) and PF EBITDA fell 11% (42.4m vs 47.7m), leaving LTM PF EBITDA at 188.4m below the 190-230m guide, and the October Microprecision bolt-on is expected slightly negative EBITDA in 2026; a low-end narrowing or soft H2 is the risk.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 print, which showed the YoY PF EBITDA decline and only reiterated, fell 6.89% over the window.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock has fallen steadily since that print, which is what a market already discounting a soft H2 looks like; the residual is whether the company actually narrows to the low end, which is not yet public. Sized small for that reason.
